title: Spherical cavity, radius 10 mm, with a coated sphere: a core (εr = 9) of radius 2.5 mm inside a ceramic sphere (εr = 4) of radius 5 mm: the TM11 triplet
source: Three-layer spherical cavity: spherical Bessel functions j₁ in the core and a combination of j₁ and y₁ in the coat and in the vacuum around it, the tangential fields continuous at both interfaces and the tangential E zero at the wall (R. F. Harrington, Time-Harmonic Electromagnetic Fields, 1961, §6.10, carried through the layers); the roots computed by emcraft-theory (bessel::coated_sphere_resonances)
